purpose: Replace legacy cap1024 Stable-Graph diagnostics for MMStar/MMBench with fresh paired cap128 results.

mmstar.score: original MMStar official L2-category macro average; report six main-category scores and overall average

mmbench.score: pinned deterministic CircularEval, no API judge or random fallback

rng: Each sample seed is first32bits of SHA256(TaskGraph-cap128-v1|task|original_index|1234); reset Python/NumPy/torch before timed forward. This differs from historical global-stream protocol. Both arms rerun.
timing: Original synchronized model forward, includes stochastic VAE encode, visual embeddings and autoregressive generation. Excludes loading, data preparation, scoring and output writes. Report mean including all examples, median, P95, warmup-excluded mean diagnostic.
gates: Identity, fixed source/weight hashes, no competing GPU process, task coverage, scorer integrity, paired input identity/seeds and smoke latent hashes. Stop on runtime/protocol failure. Never gate on speed, quality, or output equality.
limitations: Stable-Graph changes policy and outputs; no losslessness claim.
Combined policy/KV/last-position gains; no pure-KV attribution.
One full evaluation per arm, not timing variance estimation.
Other four tasks remain historical cap16; disclose heterogeneous caps when combining.
no_changes: No manuscript, GPU1/GPU2 job settings, old experiment evidence, or model algorithm changes.
dataset_loading: Public MMStar dataset token=false instead of token=true; copied Arrow bytes hash-verified. No credential transfer.
